correctness.rationale: Enumerating all nonempty sets of 15 duads whose support misses two of six ground points yields exactly 710 faces, f-vector (15,105,260,225,90,15). New modular boundary elimination gives reduced β₂=19 alone; source code’s explicit acyclic matching leaves one critical vertex and 19 critical triangles. Fresh fixed-face signed traces over all 11 S6 conjugacy types reproduce [-1,-1,1,1,1,1,1,-1,-1,-5,19]. Two independently specified source algorithms (Murnaghan–Nakayama and Young-rule Kostka inversion) support Specht irreducible multiplicities one each for (3,1,1,1) and (2,2,1,1), rational Schur realizations included. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for this specific graph.
